summary: Geography channel, Sunday teardown of Odd Atlas and WorldShift: added 3 map-answer topics (same population per country, Chile's shape, the Wakhan Corridor) and one title challenger to the weekly-loop list.
why: Odd Atlas (5.25K subs, median 56.7K views a Short) names the visible shape in 9 of its top 15 titles; WorldShift's whole-world what-ifs reach 46x its subscribers. No stayed-to-watch data of ours yet, so the title idea is a challenger, not a change.

findings.title: Odd Atlas titles name the oddity on the map
findings.detail: Triangle 554K, strip 540K, finger 277K, wall 220K, ruler 114K, all on 5.25K subscribers; our titles name the place plus a fact.

findings.title: Wakhan Corridor is in the news
